ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: With the official opening to navigation of the ship locks on the Guangxi Xijiang shipping trunk line, the Xijiang trunk line is gradually becoming a “water expressway.” Read the following figure: <image1> What is another effective measure that should be taken in the lower Xijiang River area to control local flood disasters?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure is a schematic diagram of the Xijiang shipping trunk line. The river channel is clearly curved and extends eastward from the inland area of Guangxi; along the line, place names such as Baise, Tianyang, Tiandong, Pingguo, Guigang, Guiping, and Wuzhou can be seen, and the downstream direction is close to the Wuzhou area. Then reason: The question asks what “another” effective measure should be taken in the “lower Xijiang River area” to control flood disasters. Flood control in downstream areas usually needs to enhance the flood-discharge capacity of the river channel; in addition to reinforcing levees, river-channel siltation should also be removed and the water-passing cross-section expanded, so that floodwater can be discharged downstream more smoothly. Therefore, the other measure that should be taken is to dredge the river channel.
